description: PROVENANCE (practice B12, plan risk R-A). Statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:3888-4193 together with its copybooks app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy and app/cpy/CVCUS01Y.cpy, its symbolic map app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY, the area-code and state tables in app/cpy/CSLKPCDY.cpy, and the decoded rows of the shipped fixtures app/data/ASCII/acctdata.txt, custdata.txt, cardxref.txt and carddata.txt. It was NOT captured from, recorded against, or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing these programs is empirically impossible in this environment (no z/OS and no CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository). That substitutes the PROVENANCE of the expected values and nothing else - the twenty cases, the field-for-field diffing, the diff-count-equals-zero gate and the branch-coverage bar are unchanged - and because it modifies a stated success criterion it is escalated for explicit user confirmation rather than silently absorbed (AAP 0.7.6). Every width and offset below is mechanical from the copybooks rather than taken from prose (practice B11). review_rules returns exactly one line, "No user rules provided", so NO user-specified Rule governs this file; none is cited and none is invented, and the absence is not treated as licence to lower the bar (practices B1-B12 bind in their place).  WHAT THIS CASE OWNS. 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING end to end on its one clean leg, and with it the two rewrite images every other COACTUPC write case is a perturbation of: the 300-byte account record (gate G19) and the 500-byte customer record, each carrying its trailing FILLER space-filled (gate G21). The optimistic-concurrency check of 9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC runs and finds NO change, so the rewrite proceeds (gate G43); case19 owns the change-detected leg and case20 the SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK. The total width is the self-check: a record short by exactly one span means a FILLER was omitted, which shifts every offset after it.  HOW THE STATE IS REACHED. EIBCALEN is 1033 - CARDDEMO-COMMAREA's 160 bytes followed by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA's 873 - so :888-892 restores both halves and the inbound ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION of 'N' (88 ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED, :664) survives. YYYY-STORE-PFKEY resolves EIBAID to CCARD-AID-PFK05, and the PF-key gate at :905-916 admits PF05 ONLY in that state - in any other it would be remapped to ENTER at :914-916. The top-level EVALUATE therefore falls to WHEN OTHER at :996-1003, which performs 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION and 3000-SEND-MAP in that order. 1100-RECEIVE-MAP rebuilds ACUP-NEW-DETAILS from the returned screen after INITIALIZE at :1047, each of the five monetary fields guarded by IF FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL-C(...) = 0 before its COMPUTE (:1078, :1092, :1106, :1120, :1134). 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS then performs 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW at :1460 and immediately SHORT-CIRCUITS at :1463-1468, because ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED is the second disjunct of IF NO-CHANGES-FOUND OR ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED OR ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE: it moves LOW-VALUES to WS-NON-KEY-FLAGS and leaves. So NO field edit runs on THIS interaction and 1205's verdict is immaterial here. The state 'N' is nevertheless only reachable because every edit passed on the PREVIOUS interaction (:1671-1674), which is why the screen values this case carries are edit-clean.  THE SEVEN STEPS OF 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING, IN ORDER. (1) :3892-3903 MOVE CC-ACCT-ID TO WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID then EXEC CICS READ FILE(LIT-ACCTFILENAME) UPDATE; :3907-3915 takes the DFHRESP(NORMAL) arm, so neither INPUT-ERROR nor COULD-NOT-LOCK-ACCT-FOR-UPDATE is set. (2) :3919-3930 MOVE CDEMO-CUST-ID TO WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID then the same shape on FILE(LIT-CUSTFILENAME); :3934-3942 NORMAL again, so COULD-NOT-LOCK-CUST-FOR-UPDATE is not set. (3) :3947-3952 PERFORM 9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC THRU its exit: all THIRTY-FIVE comparisons agree - sixteen account items at :4115-4140 and nineteen customer items at :4152-4186 - so DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE stays off and the paragraph does not leave early. The zip comparison passes because :4168 compares the stored CUST-ADDR-ZIP against the FULL ten-byte ACUP-OLD-CUST-ADDR-ZIP snapshot taken at :3875, not against the five bytes the screen returned; the group identifier passes because :4139-4140 folds both operands with FUNCTION LOWER-CASE and both are ten spaces. (4) :3956 INITIALIZE ACCT-UPDATE-RECORD then the eleven moves at :3960-4002. (5) :4007 INITIALIZE CUST-UPDATE-RECORD then the eighteen moves at :4009-4059. (6) :4065-4071 EXEC CICS REWRITE FILE(LIT-ACCTFILENAME) FROM(ACCT-UPDATE-RECORD) LENGTH(LENGTH OF ACCT-UPDATE-RECORD) - the whole declared 300 bytes, FILLER included - and :4076-4081 takes NORMAL, so LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED is not set. (7) :4085-4091 the same for CUST-UPDATE-RECORD and :4095-4103 takes NORMAL, so the EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK at :4099-4101 is NOT reached. Four call sites, all four on the DFHRESP(NORMAL) arm (gate G47), and every one of them reaches it from genuinely seeded rows rather than from a forced repository outcome - which is why "forcedOutcomes" is empty.  THE OUTCOME, AND WHY IT IS 'C'. Back in 2000-DECIDE-ACTION the inner EVALUATE TRUE at :2606-2615 runs in source order (gate G30): WHEN COULD-NOT-LOCK-ACCT-FOR-UPDATE gives 'L', WHEN LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED gives 'F', WHEN DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE sets ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS, and WHEN OTHER sets ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE. None of the first three flags is set here, so this path lands on WHEN OTHER and ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION becomes 'C' (:665). 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG at :2957-2977 then reaches WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE and SETs CONFIRM-UPDATE-SUCCESS, whose literal is 'Changes committed to database' on WS-INFO-MSG PIC X(40) (:463, :474-475). That arm is the ONLY one of the eight that produces this literal, so the single emitted line is a discriminating assertion that the state really is 'C'. :2979 MOVEs the forty bytes into INFOMSGO PIC X(45), where they are right-space-padded to 45, and :2981 MOVEs WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) into ERRMSGO PIC X(78), which is seventy-eight spaces because WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF was set at :876 and nothing on this path turns it on. The screen projection itself belongs to the CONTROLLER_POJO cases; this case drives the service, so it asserts the message and the bytes. On the NEXT interaction the top-level EVALUATE's WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE arm at :979-989 resets the search keys - INITIALIZE WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, WS-MISC-STORAGE and CDEMO-ACCT-ID, SET CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, then ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED - and 2000-DECIDE-ACTION's own arm at :2625-2632 zeroes CDEMO-ACCT-ID and CDEMO-CARD-NUM and moves LOW-VALUES to CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS when CDEMO-FROM-TRANID is LOW-VALUES or SPACES, as it is here. This case's expectation stops at 'C'.  THE ACCOUNT IMAGE, AND THE LAYOUT DEFECT IT MAKES VISIBLE (practice B5). ACCT-UPDATE-RECORD at :418-433 is NOT app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy. It declares no ADDR-ZIP span and closes with FILLER PIC X(188) rather than X(178), and 11+1+12+12+12+10+10+10+12+12+10+188 is still 300. So :4002 MOVE ACUP-NEW-GROUP-ID TO ACCT-UPDATE-GROUP-ID writes ten bytes at offset 102, which is exactly where the stored record keeps ACCT-ADDR-ZIP, and the stored ACCT-GROUP-ID span at offset 112 falls inside the 188-byte reserved area and is blanked. Account 00000000034's stored ACCT-ADDR-ZIP of 'A000000000' is therefore DESTROYED by the rewrite and replaced by ACUP-NEW-GROUP-ID, which is LOW-VALUES because :1213-1217 maps a blank or '*' AADDGRPI to LOW-VALUES rather than to spaces. This is reproduced, not repaired. The five monetary fields come from their -N views (:3964-3974) as twelve zoned DISPLAY characters at scale exactly 2 (gate G23) with the sign carried as an overpunch in the trailing byte: '00000002530{' is 253.00, '00000036420{' is 3642.00, '00000027700{' is 2770.00 and '00000000000{' is 0.00 twice, the '{' being a positive-zero overpunch. No rounding occurs in the build itself; the values arrive already truncated toward zero at scale 2, because ROUNDED appears zero times in all 28 programs and RoundingMode.DOWN is the only faithful mode (gate G24). The three dates are recomposed by STRING year '-' mon '-' day DELIMITED BY SIZE at :3976-3982, :3984-3990 and :3994-4000, giving the ten-byte hyphenated CCYY-MM-DD form; the receiver at :3990 is the misspelled ACCT-UPDATE-EXPIRAION-DATE and the field name is used verbatim here as ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE, never corrected. A DEAD STATEMENT IS PRESERVED: :3993 MOVE ACCT-REISSUE-DATE TO ACCT-UPDATE-REISSUE-DATE is overwritten in full by the STRING at :3994-4000 into the same ten-byte field, so it is a no-op; ACCT-REISSUE-DATE below holds the STRING-composed value, which is what proves the MOVE changed nothing.  THE CUSTOMER IMAGE. The eighteen moves at :4009-4059 in copybook order. Both telephone numbers are recomposed by STRING '(' area ')' prefix '-' line DELIMITED BY SIZE (:4027-4033 and :4035-4041), which writes thirteen of the fifteen declared characters and leaves the last two as INITIALIZE left them, so each is (NNN)NNN-NNNN right-space-padded to exactly 15 - the same form the fixture already holds. The date of birth is recomposed the same way at :4047-4052 into the ten-byte hyphenated form. A SECOND DEFECT IS PRESERVED: ACSZIPCI is PIC X(5) in the symbolic map while CUST-ADDR-ZIP is PIC X(10), so :2843 and :2937 truncate ten bytes to five on the way to the screen and :1354 space-pads five back to ten on the way in. The stored '49544-2869' therefore returns as '49544' and the rewrite stores '49544     ', losing the '-2869' suffix. That loss is legacy behaviour and is asserted, not repaired. CUST-UPDATE-RECORD's own FILLER at :456 is PIC X(168), the same width CVCUS01Y declares, so this record carries no layout defect and the image agrees span for span with the copybook.  THE SEED, AND THE TWO OVERRIDES IT FORCES. Account 00000000034 and customer 000000034 are row 33 of acctdata.txt and custdata.txt; the cross-reference row 18 of cardxref.txt binds card 4385271476627819 to them and row 18 of carddata.txt is that card. Customer 000000034 is the only one of the fifty whose state code and zip pass the cross-field edit at 1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD: 'ME' is among the 56 literals of VALID-US-STATE-CODE and the probe 'ME49' is among the 240 literals of VALID-US-STATE-ZIP-CD2-COMBO. Two of its stored values would nevertheless have failed the edits that must have passed for the state to be 'N', so both are overridden on the returned screen and both are named here rather than left to be discovered. FIRST, ACSPH1AI: the stored phone-1 area code '179' is NOT among the 410 literals of VALID-GENERAL-PURP-CODE, so EDIT-AREA-CODE at :2296-2312 would set INPUT-ERROR and FLG-EDIT-US-PHONEA-NOT-OK; it is replaced by '303', which is in that set, giving '(303)036-5135  '. Phone 2's area code '986' IS in the set and is left alone. SECOND, ACSTFCOI: the stored FICO score of 104 fails 88 FICO-RANGE-IS-VALID VALUES 300 THROUGH 850 (:848-849), which 1275-EDIT-FICO-SCORE enforces at :2514-2529; it is replaced by 300, the inclusive lower bound and so the smallest value that passes. Each override is by itself a genuine change, so 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW would report CHANGE-HAS-OCCURRED on the prior interaction and no third, invented change is needed - and the zip truncation described above is a change as well, since :1745-1747 compares the trimmed new and old values. Everything else the screen returns is exactly what 3203-SHOW-UPDATED-VALUES painted from ACUP-NEW-DETAILS at :2870-2947, including the five monetary fields rendered through WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F PIC +ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.99 (:371), which is why they arrive as '+        253.00', '+      3,642.00', '+      2,770.00' and '+           .00' twice. All four forms satisfy FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL-C and FUNCTION NUMVAL-C returns the stored value unchanged for each.  WHAT IS ASSERTED AND WHAT IS NOT. The unit is account.AccountUpdateService, driven directly: no HTTP layer, no MockMvc and no JobLauncher stand between the assertion and the arithmetic (gate G51), which is also why "expectedResponse" is absent - a service paints no screen, and claiming one would assert a response the unit cannot produce. Conversation state travels entirely in the payload here, in "commarea" and "mapFields", with nothing held server-side (gate G37). The code page is named explicitly as US-ASCII rather than left to the platform default (practice B8): it is the code page of the nine shipped ASCII fixtures, and IBM037 would be the choice for app/data/EBCDIC, which this case does not read. "expectedWrites" carries the two rewrites in the order the source issues them, account then customer; "expectedFinalState" carries the two rewritten rows plus the cross-reference and card rows byte-identical to their seeds, which is the positive assertion that this rewrite touches neither of them. The cross-reference rows are seeded RAW at the fixture's 36 bytes and padded to CVACT03Y's 50 once at seed time by the CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation, never at comparison time (gate G16). No version column, no DDL and no schema artefact appears anywhere: the concurrency check is reproduced field for field from :4109-4191 and nothing is added to the datasets to support it (gate G44 in spirit). NOT APPLICABLE to this case and stated so rather than left silent: gate G32, because COACTUPC contains no backward loop-forming GO TO - CBSTM03A is the only program that does - and gate G35, because no CALL 'CEE3ABD' exists in this program and the SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK at :4099-4101 is not reached on the clean path, so the return code is 0. A DIVERGENCE IS DOCUMENTED RATHER THAN SILENTLY RESOLVED (practice B4): COACTUPCParityTest's own prose describes case15 through case20 as CONTROLLER_POJO cases, while the shipped fixtures - case01 and case04 among them - use the opposite assignment and case15 is a SERVICE case. This file follows the fixtures and the plan's own direction that parity tests reach services rather than controllers, and the disagreement is recorded here for a reader rather than repaired in a file this case does not own.
